sdlc_incident_management_examples.overview: Complete examples of incident management workflows for different incident types, showing how the mode adapts to various scenarios.

example.name: performance_incident
example.user_report: "Users are reporting that the application is very slow. Pages are taking 3-5 seconds to load."

step.bob_action: I'll create a ServiceNow incident to track this performance issue. Let me gather the details: - Short description: Application experiencing slow response times - Description: Users reporting 3-5 second delays when accessing pages - Urgency: Medium (2) - significant degradation but system functional - Impact: Medium (2) - affecting multiple users
step.result: Incident INC0010042 created successfully

step.bob_action: Now I'll run a health check to diagnose the performance issue. This will check all services and measure response times.
step.result:
Health check shows: - Backend: responding but slow (3.2s) - Frontend: normal (0.1s) - Database: normal (0.05s)
Root cause: Backend performance degradation
step.bob_action: I've identified the issue - the backend is responding slowly. Let me update ServiceNow with these findings.
I'll run the fix-performance playbook to address the backend slowness.
step.result: Performance fix applied successfully

step.bob_action: Let me verify the fix by running the health check again.
step.result:
Health check shows: - Backend: normal (0.08s) - 40x improvement! - Frontend: normal (0.1s) - Database: normal (0.05s)
All services healthy and performing normally.

step.bob_action: Performance issue resolved. Updating ServiceNow incident to resolved state.

tool_use.work_notes: Performance issue resolved. Backend response time improved from 3.2s to 0.08s. Applied fix-performance playbook. All services now healthy.

step.result: Incident INC0010042 marked as Resolved

example.name: deployment_failure
example.user_report: "The deployment we just did is causing errors. Users can't log in."

step.bob_action: I'll create a high-priority incident for this deployment failure. - Short description: Deployment failure causing login errors - Description: Recent deployment preventing user authentication - Urgency: High (1) - users cannot access system - Impact: High (1) - affects all users
step.result: Incident INC0010043 created with high priority

step.bob_action: Let me check the current state of the application.
step.result:
Health check shows: - Backend: errors in authentication module - Frontend: unable to connect to backend auth endpoint - Database: normal
Root cause: Recent deployment broke authentication

step.bob_action:
Since the recent deployment caused this, I recommend rolling back to the previous working version. This will restore functionality while we investigate the deployment issue.
Shall I proceed with the rollback?
step.result: Rollback completed successfully

step.bob_action: Verifying that the rollback restored functionality.
step.result: All services healthy. Authentication working normally. Users can now log in successfully.

step.bob_action:
Deployment failure resolved via rollback. Updating incident.
Note: The failed deployment should be investigated separately to identify and fix the authentication issue before redeploying.
step.result: Incident INC0010043 resolved. Follow-up task created to investigate deployment failure.

example.name: configuration_issue
example.user_report: "The application is connecting to the wrong database. We need to update the configuration."

step.bob_action: Creating incident for configuration issue. - Short description: Application using incorrect database configuration - Description: Need to update database connection settings - Urgency: Medium (2) - Impact: Medium (2)
step.result: Incident INC0010044 created

step.bob_action: Let me check the current configuration and verify the issue.
step.result: Current configuration shows connection to development database. Should be using production database.

step.bob_action: I'll run the update-config playbook to apply the correct database settings.
step.result: Configuration updated successfully

step.bob_action: Verifying the configuration change.
step.result: Application now connected to correct production database. All services healthy.

step.bob_action: Configuration issue resolved. Database settings updated to production.
step.result: Incident INC0010044 resolved

example.name: backup_request
example.scenario: Need to perform database backup before maintenance
example.user_report: "We need to backup the database before the scheduled maintenance window."

step.bob_action: Creating incident for backup operation. - Short description: Database backup required for maintenance - Description: Backup needed before scheduled maintenance window - Urgency: Medium (2) - Impact: Low (3) - preventive action
step.result: Incident INC0010045 created

step.bob_action: This is a backup operation. I'll verify the database is accessible and ready for backup.
step.result: Database is healthy and accessible

step.bob_action: Running database backup playbook.
step.result: Database backup completed successfully. Backup file: backup_2026-02-25_23-00-00.sql Size: 2.3 GB Location: /backups/

step.bob_action: Verifying backup file integrity.
step.result: Backup file exists and is complete (2.3 GB)

step.bob_action: Database backup completed successfully. System ready for maintenance.
step.result: Incident INC0010045 resolved

example.name: missing_playbook
example.bob_response: I notice the fix-performance playbook isn't available in the expected location. Let me check what playbooks are available and suggest alternatives.
example.adaptation: Based on available playbooks, I can use manual commands to address the issue, or we can create a new playbook for this specific scenario.

example.name: servicenow_unavailable
example.bob_response: I'm unable to connect to ServiceNow at the moment. I'll proceed with incident management using manual tracking and update ServiceNow when it becomes available.
example.adaptation: - Document all actions in conversation - Maintain incident details locally - Provide summary for manual ServiceNow entry - Continue with diagnosis and remediation

example.name: complex_incident
example.bob_response: The initial fix didn't fully resolve the issue. Let me run diagnostics again to see the current state and determine next steps.
example.adaptation: - Re-run health checks - Analyze what changed and what didn't - Try alternative remediation approach - Document each attempt in ServiceNow - Escalate if multiple attempts fail

pattern.name: status_update
pattern.example: Health check completed. Backend showing slow response (3.2s). Now I'll run the fix-performance playbook to address this.

pattern.name: seeking_confirmation
pattern.template: I recommend [action] because [reason]. This will [impact]. Shall I proceed?
pattern.example: I recommend rolling back the deployment because it's causing authentication failures. This will restore functionality while we investigate the issue. Shall I proceed with the rollback?

pattern.name: explaining_findings
pattern.template: Diagnosis complete. [Summary of findings]. Root cause: [cause]. [Recommended action].
pattern.example: Diagnosis complete. The health check shows the backend is responding slowly (3.2s) while other services are normal. Root cause: Backend performance degradation. I'll apply the fix-performance playbook to resolve this.
